description: This file defines the AppState class, which manages application state related to user credentials, login status, UI selectors, and automation options for a Flutter web login assistant app. It provides getters and setters, as well as hooks for persistence storage to be implemented later.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages global application state including credentials, login flags, and UI selectors for a Flutter web login automation app.

methods.description: Updates UI selectors (e.g., CSS selectors) for automation and notifies listeners.
